## Summary

Continues ADR 0121 Asset/Prefab parity with shared prefab creation and instantiation semantics.

- adds a GUI-free PrefabAuthoringService over SceneAuthoringService for preview/apply, stale revision/generation protection, one transaction, and one undo entry
- moves prefab instance marker semantics into the shared authoring layer and routes Editor instantiate through it
- fixes nested-root prefab capture so external Scene parents cannot leak into standalone prefab documents
- adds PrefabAssetService for safe root+descendant capture, .prefab.json persistence, fresh AssetId registration, manifest persistence, and rollback of newly-created files on manifest failure
- routes Editor Save as Prefab through the shared asset service
- exposes prefab.create, prefab.preview, and prefab.instantiate through MCP and equivalent headless CLI commands
- enforces shared Read / Preview / ProjectDataWrite / AssetWrite permissions and ProjectRoot path confinement
- adds shared service tests for descendants, root detachment, manifest registration, path/permission safety, non-destructive preview, one-undo apply, and stale-base rejection

Cargo.lock changes because the Editor now directly depends on engine-assets, so Windows Validation must run in full mode.
